// Parse deal update from CRM webhook
const update = $input.first().json;

const dealUpdate = {
  dealId: update.id || update.dealId,
  dealName: update.name || update.dealName,
  company: update.company || update.account,
  amount: update.amount || update.value,
  previousAmount: update.previous_amount || update.previousAmount,
  currency: update.currency || 'USD',
  stage: update.stage || update.current_stage,
  previousStage: update.previous_stage || update.previousStage,
  owner: update.owner || update.owner_name,
  ownerEmail: update.owner_email || update.ownerEmail,
  expectedCloseDate: update.close_date || update.expectedCloseDate,
  previousCloseDate: update.previous_close_date || update.previousCloseDate,
  lossReason: update.loss_reason || update.lossReason,
  competitor: update.competitor,
  notes: update.notes,
  updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  
  // Determine update type
  isStageChange: update.stage !== update.previous_stage,
  isWon: update.stage === 'Closed Won',
  isLost: update.stage === 'Closed Lost',
  isAmountChange: update.amount !== update.previous_amount,
  isCloseDateChange: update.close_date !== update.previous_close_date
};

return { json: dealUpdate };
